Type and creator are not on this form on purpose — the backend\n\/\/ stamps them from the fact that a logged-in user posted it, and offering them\n\/\/ would invite a manual lead that claims to be a website one.\n\/\/\n\/\/ Duplicate detection runs twice, and both are needed: this form warns while\n\/\/ the user types (cheap, advisory, dismissible), and the POST re-checks\n\/\/ server-side (authoritative, race-free). A warning here is a courtesy; the 409\n\/\/ is the actual guard.\nexport default function AddLeadModal({ onClose, onCreated, choices }) {\n  const [form, setForm] = useState({\n    business_name: '',\n    name: '',\n    phone: '',\n    whatsapp: '',\n    email: '',\n    area: '',\n    category: '',\n    source: 'manual',\n    status: 'new_lead',\n    priority: 'medium',\n    temperature: 'warm',\n    assigned_sales: '',\n    notes: '',\n  })\n  const [err, setErr] = useState('')\n  const [dupes, setDupes] = useState(null) \/\/ set when the server says 409\n\n  const create = useCreateLead()\n  const { data: salesUsers } = useSalesUsers()\n\n  \/\/ Debounced so typing a phone number is not eleven requests.\n  const probe = useDebounced({ phone: form.phone, business_name: form.business_name }, 400)\n  const { data: liveDupes } = useDuplicateCheck(probe)\n\n  const set = (k) => (e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value }))\n  const canSubmit = form.business_name.trim() && form.phone.trim() && !create.isPending\n\n  async function submit(e, { force = false } = {}) {\n    e?.preventDefault()\n    setErr('')\n    try {\n      const body = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(form).filter(([, v]) => v !== ''))\n      const lead = await create.mutateAsync({ ...body, force })\n      onCreated?.(lead)\n      onClose()\n    } catch (e2) {\n      const data = e2.response?.data?.error\n      if (e2.response?.status === 409 && data?.code === 'POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE') {\n        setDupes(data.duplicates ?? [])\n        return\n      }\n      setErr(normalizeError(e2).message)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black\/50 p-4\">\n      <form\n        onSubmit={submit}\n        className=\"my-8 w-full max-w-2xl rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5\"\n      >\n        <div className=\"mb-4 flex items-start justify-between\">\n          <div>\n            <h2 className=\"font-head text-lg font-semibold text-tx\">Add Lead<\/h2>\n            <p className=\"mt-0.5 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n              Created as a manual lead under your name.\n            <\/p>\n          <\/div>\n          <button type=\"button\" onClick={onClose} className=\"text-tx-3 hover:text-tx\">\n            <X size={18} \/>\n          <\/button>\n        <\/div>\n\n        {dupes ? (\n          <DuplicateWarning\n            duplicates={dupes}\n            onOpen={onClose}\n            onBack={() => setDupes(null)}\n            onForce={(e) => submit(e, { force: true })}\n            busy={create.isPending}\n          \/>\n        ) : (\n          <>\n            {liveDupes?.length > 0 && (\n              <div className=\"mb-4 flex items-start gap-2 rounded-ctl border border-warn\/40 bg-warn\/10 p-3 text-xs text-warn\">\n                <AlertTriangle size={14} className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0\" \/>\n                <span>\n                  {liveDupes.length === 1\n                    ? `${liveDupes[0].business_name} already has a lead with this phone or name.`\n                    : `${liveDupes.length} existing leads match this phone or name.`}\n                <\/span>\n              <\/div>\n            )}\n\n            <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2\">\n              <Field label=\"Business name\" required value={form.business_name} onChange={set('business_name')} \/>\n              <Field label=\"Owner\" value={form.name} onChange={set('name')} \/>\n              <Field label=\"Phone\" required value={form.phone} onChange={set('phone')} \/>\n              <Field label=\"WhatsApp\" value={form.whatsapp} onChange={set('whatsapp')} \/>\n              <Field label=\"Email\" type=\"email\" value={form.email} onChange={set('email')} \/>\n              <Field label=\"Area\" value={form.area} onChange={set('area')} \/>\n\n              <Picker label=\"Category\" value={form.category} onChange={set('category')} blank=\"—\">\n                {optionsFor(choices, KIND.CATEGORY).map((c) => (\n                  <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                    {c.label}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n              <Picker label=\"Source\" value={form.source} onChange={set('source')}>\n                {optionsFor(choices, KIND.SOURCE).map((c) => (\n                  <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                    {c.label}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n              <Picker label=\"Status\" value={form.status} onChange={set('status')}>\n                {optionsFor(choices, KIND.STATUS).map((c) => (\n                  <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                    {c.label}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n              <Picker label=\"Priority\" value={form.priority} onChange={set('priority')}>\n                {optionsFor(choices, KIND.PRIORITY).map((c) => (\n                  <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                    {c.label}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n              <Picker label=\"Temperature\" value={form.temperature} onChange={set('temperature')}>\n                {optionsFor(choices, KIND.TEMPERATURE).map((c) => (\n                  <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                    {c.label}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n              <Picker\n                label=\"Assigned sales\"\n                value={form.assigned_sales}\n                onChange={set('assigned_sales')}\n                blank=\"Unassigned\"\n              >\n                {(salesUsers ?? []).map((a) => (\n                  <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>\n                    {a.name || a.email}\n                  <\/option>\n                ))}\n              <\/Picker>\n            <\/div>\n\n            <label className=\"mt-3 flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n              Notes\n              <textarea\n                value={form.notes}\n                onChange={set('notes')}\n                rows={3}\n                className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-tx focus:border-brand focus:outline-none\"\n              \/>\n            <\/label>\n\n            {err && <div className=\"mt-3 text-sm text-danger\">{err}<\/div>}\n\n            <div className=\"mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={onClose}\n                className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line px-4 py-2 text-sm text-tx-2 hover:text-tx\"\n              >\n                Cancel\n              <\/button>\n              <button\n                type=\"submit\"\n                disabled={!canSubmit}\n                className=\"flex items-center gap-2 rounded-ctl bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-d disabled:opacity-50\"\n              >\n                {create.isPending && <Loader2 size={14} className=\"animate-spin\" \/>}\n                Add Lead\n              <\/button>\n            <\/div>\n          <\/>\n        )}\n      <\/form>\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\n\/\/ The three ways out of a duplicate, exactly as the spec rounded-ctl border border-warn\/40 bg-warn\/10 p-3 text-sm text-warn\">\n        <AlertTriangle size={16} className=\"mt-0.5 shrink-0\" \/>\n        <div>\n          <div className=\"font-semibold\">This lead may already exist<\/div>\n          <div className=\"mt-0.5 text-xs opacity-90\">\n            Matching on phone, email or business name.\n          <\/div>\n        <\/div>\n      <\/div>\n\n      <ul className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n        {duplicates.map((d) => (\n          <li\n            key={d.id}\n            className=\"flex items-center justify-between rounded-ctl border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-2\"\n          >\n            <div>\n              <div className=\"text-sm font-medium text-tx\">{d.business_name}<\/div>\n              <div className=\"font-num text-xs text-tx-3\">\n                {d.phone} · {d.assigned_sales?.name || d.assigned_sales?.email || 'Unassigned'}\n              <\/div>\n            <\/div>\n            <a\n              href={`\/leads\/${d.id}`}\n              onClick={onOpen}\n              className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-tx-2 hover:border-brand hover:text-brand\"\n            >\n              Open\n            <\/a>\n          <\/li>\n        ))}\n      <\/ul>\n\n      <div className=\"mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={onBack}\n          className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line px-4 py-2 text-sm text-tx-2 hover:text-tx\"\n        >\n          Back\n        <\/button>\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={onForce}\n          disabled={busy}\n          className=\"flex items-center gap-2 rounded-ctl border border-warn px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-warn hover:bg-warn\/10 disabled:opacity-50\"\n        >\n          {busy && <Loader2 size={14} className=\"animate-spin\" \/>}\n          Create anyway\n        <\/button>\n      <\/div>\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\nconst inputClass =\n  'rounded-ctl border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-tx placeholder:text-tx-3 focus:border-brand focus:outline-none'\n\nfunction Field({ label, required, ...props }) {\n  return (\n    <label className=\"flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n      <span>\n        {label}\n        {required && <span className=\"ml-0.5 return (\n    <label className=\"flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n      {label}\n      <select {...props} className={inputClass}>\n        {blank && <option value=\"\">{blank}<\/option>}\n        {children}\n      <\/select>\n    <\/label>\n  )\n}\n",

{
  "content" : "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\n\n\/\/ Return `value` after it has stopped changing for `delay` ms.\n\/\/\n\/\/ Used for the things that hit the API on every keystroke — the table's search\n\/\/ box and the Add Lead duplicate probe. Without it, typing an eleven-digit phone\n\/\/ number is eleven requests, ten of which are already stale when they land.\n\/\/\n\/\/ Objects are compared by their JSON, not by identity: callers pass a fresh\n\/\/ object literal every render, so an identity check would never settle.\nexport function useDebounced(value, delay = 300) {\n  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(value)\n  const serialized = JSON.stringify(value)\n  const latest = useRef(value)\n  latest.current = value\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const t = setTimeout(() => setSettled(latest.current), delay)\n    return () => clearTimeout(t)\n  }, [serialized, delay])\n\n  return settled\n}\n",
  "file_path" : "\/Users\/momen\/My Projects\/Kasbana\/frontend\/admin\/src\/features\/leads\/useDebounced.js"
}

A\n\/\/ bulk endpoint would be one request and one audit line for forty leads.\n\/\/\n\/\/ The cost is N requests, so the count is capped: past that, the fan-out is\n\/\/ slow enough that it deserves a real endpoint rather than a loop with a\n\/\/ progress bar pretending to be one.\nconst MAX_BULK = 50\n\nexport default function BulkBar({ selected, onClear, choices }) {\n  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)\n  const [done, setDone] = useState(0)\n  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(0)\n  const update = useUpdateLead()\n  const { data: salesUsers } = useSalesUsers()\n\n  const ids = [...selected]\n  const tooMany = ids.length > MAX_BULK\n\n  async function applyToAll(patch) {\n    setBusy(true)\n    setDone(0)\n    setFailed(0)\n    \/\/ Sequential, not Promise.all: forty parallel writes to the same table is a\n    \/\/ good way to turn a convenience into an incident, and this is a background\n    \/\/ chore, not something anyone is watching a spinner for.\n    let ok = 0\n    let bad = 0\n    for (const id of ids) {\n      try {\n        await update.mutateAsync({ id, ...patch })\n        setDone(++ok)\n      } catch {\n        \/\/ One lead failing must not abandon the other thirty-nine — report the\n        \/\/ count at the end instead.\n        setFailed(++bad)\n      }\n    }\n    setBusy(false)\n    if (bad === 0) onClear()\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-brand\/40 bg-brand-bg\/40 px-4 py-3\">\n      <span className=\"text-sm font-semibold text-tx\">\n        {ids.length} selected\n      <\/span>\n\n      {tooMany ? (\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-warn\">\n          Select {MAX_BULK} or fewer to apply a bulk change.\n        <\/span>\n      ) : busy ? (\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-tx-2\">\n          <Loader2 size={13} className=\"animate-spin\" \/>\n          Updating {done + failed} of {ids.length}…\n        <\/span>\n      ) : (\n        <>\n          <select\n            defaultValue=\"\"\n            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && applyToAll({ status: e.target.value })}\n            className={selectClass}\n          >\n            <option value=\"\">Set status…<\/option>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.STATUS).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/select>\n\n          <select\n            defaultValue=\"\"\n            onChange={(e) => e.target.value && applyToAll({ priority: e.target.value })}\n            className={selectClass}\n          >\n            <option value=\"\">Set priority…<\/option>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.PRIORITY).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/select>\n\n          <select\n            defaultValue=\"\"\n            onChange={(e) =>\n              e.target.value &&\n              applyToAll({ assigned_sales: e.target.value === '__none__' ? null : e.target.value })\n            }\n            className={selectClass}\n          >\n            <option value=\"\">Assign to…<\/option>\n            <option value=\"__none__\">Unassign<\/option>\n            {(salesUsers ?? <LeadsTable\n        rows={rows}\n        choices={choices}\n        isLoading={isLoading}\n        visible={visible}\n        sort={sort}\n        onSort={setSort}\n        selected={selected}\n The backend's ActivityKind is the source of truth for\n\/\/ which of these exist; anything unmapped falls back to a neutral dot rather\n\/\/ than crashing, so a release that adds a kind degrades quietly.\nconst ICONS = {\n  lead_created: UserPlus,\n  website_form_submitted: Globe,\n  manual_lead_created: UserPlus,\n  phone_call_logged: PhoneCall,\n  whatsapp_sent: MessageCircle,\n  email_sent: Mail,\n  priority_changed: Flag,\n  status_changed: ArrowRightLeft,\n  assigned_sales_changed: ArrowRightLeft,\n  demo_scheduled: CalendarClock,\n  demo_completed: CalendarCheck,\n  proposal_sent: FileText,\n  converted_to_merchant: Trophy,\n  closed: XCircle,\n  note_added: StickyNote,\n}\n\nconst TONES = {\n  converted_to_merchant: 'text-success',\n  demo_scheduled: 'text-warn',\n  demo_completed: 'text-warn',\n  proposal_sent: 'text-warn',\n  closed: 'text-tx-3',\n  website_form_submitted: 'text-info',\n}\n\nexport default function LeadTimeline({ activities = [] }) {\n  if (activities.length === 0) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-8 text-center\">\n        <CheckCircle2 size={22} className=\"mx-auto mb-2 text-tx-3\" \/>\n        <div className=\"text-sm text-tx-2\">Nothing has happened yet.<\/div>\n        <div className=\"mt-1 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n          Every change to this lead lands here automatically.\n        <\/div>\n      <\/div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <ol className=\"flex flex-col\">\n      {activities.map((a, i) => {\n        const Icon = ICONS[a.kind] ?? CheckCircle2\n        const last = i === activities.length - 1\n\n        return (\n          <li key={a.id} className=\"flex gap-3\">\n            {\/* The rail: an icon per entry with a line joining them, cut short\n                on the last so the timeline ends rather than trailing off. *\/}\n            <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n              <div className=\"flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line bg-surface-2\">\n                <Icon size={13} className={TONES[a.kind] ?? 'text-tx-2'} \/>\n              <\/div>\n              {!last && <div className=\"w-px flex-1 bg-line\" \/>}\n            <\/div>\n\n            <div className={`flex-1 ${last ? 'pb-0' : 'pb-5'}`}>\n              <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2\">\n                <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-tx\">{a.title}<\/span>\n                <span className=\"text-xs text-tx-3\" title={new Date(a.created_at).toLocaleString()}>\n                  {fromNow(a.created_at)}\n                <\/span>\n              <\/div>\n              {a.description && (\n                <div className=\"mt-0.5 text-sm text-tx-2\">{a.description}<\/div>\n              )}\n              <div className=\"mt-0.5 text-xs text-tx-3\">{a.actor_label || 'System'}<\/div>\n            <\/div>\n          <\/li>\n        )\n      })}\n    <\/ol>\n  )\n}\n",
  "file_path" : "\/Users\/momen\/My Projects\/Kasbana\/frontend\/admin\/src\/features\/leads\/LeadTimeline.jsx"
}

  "content" : "import { useState } from 'react'\nimport { Loader2, PhoneCall, X } from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useLogCall } from '.\/api'\nimport { KIND, optionsFor } from '.\/crm'\nimport { normalizeError } from '..\/..\/lib\/api'\n\n\/\/ Log Call.\n\/\/\n\/\/ Call results are their own fixed vocabulary (CallResult on the backend), not\n\/\/ the lead's status list: a call's outcome and a lead's state are different\n\/\/ things, and a call cannot result in \"Converted\". They are not configurable in\n\/\/ Settings for the same reason.\nconst RESULTS = [\n  { slug: 'answered', label: 'Answered' },\n  { slug: 'no_answer', label: 'No Answer' },\n  { slug: 'busy', label: 'Busy' },\n  { slug: 'phone_off', label: 'Phone Off' },\n  { slug: 'wrong_number', label: 'Wrong Number' },\n  { slug: 'reception_answered', label: 'Reception Answered' },\n  { slug: 'manager_answered', label: 'Manager Answered' },\n  { slug: 'owner_answered', label: 'Owner Answered' },\n  { slug: 'call_back_later', label: 'Call Back Later' },\n  { slug: 'not_interested', label: 'Not Interested' },\n]\n\n\/\/ Datetime-local wants `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` in *local* time — toISOString would\n\/\/ hand it UTC and silently shift the default by the timezone offset.\nfunction localNow() {\n  const d = new Date()\n  d.setMinutes(d.getMinutes() - d.getTimezoneOffset())\n  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 16)\n}\n\nexport default function LogCallModal({ leadId, onClose, choices }) {\n  const [form, setForm] = useState({\n    called_at: localNow(),\n    duration_minutes: '',\n    result: 'answered',\n    contact_method: 'phone',\n    next_follow_up_at: '',\n    notes: '',\n  })\n  const [err, setErr] = useState('')\n  const log = useLogCall()\n\n  const set = (k) => (e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value }))\n\n  async function submit(e) {\n    e.preventDefault()\n    setErr('')\n    try {\n      await log.mutateAsync({\n        leadId,\n        called_at: new Date(form.called_at).toISOString(),\n        \/\/ The form asks for minutes because that is how people think about a\n        \/\/ call; the API stores seconds because that is what it is.\n        duration_seconds: Math.round((Number(form.duration_minutes) || 0) * 60),\n        result: form.result,\n        contact_method: form.contact_method,\n        next_follow_up_at: form.next_follow_up_at\n          ? new Date(form.next_follow_up_at).toISOString()\n          : null,\n        notes: form.notes,\n      })\n      onClose()\n    } catch (e2) {\n      setErr(normalizeError(e2).message)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black\/50 p-4\" onClick={onClose}>\n      <form\n        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\n        onSubmit={submit}\n        className=\"w-full max-w-md rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5\"\n      >\n        <div className=\"mb-4 flex items-start justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-tx\">\n            <PhoneCall size={17} className=\"text-brand\" \/>\n            <h2 className=\"font-head font-semibold\">Log Call<\/h2>\n          <\/div>\n          <button type=\"button\" onClick={onClose} className=\"text-tx-3 hover:text-tx\">\n            <X size={18} \/>\n          <\/button>\n        <\/div>\n\n        <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\n          <Labelled label=\"Call date\">\n            <input\n              type=\"datetime-local\"\n              value={form.called_at}\n              onChange={set('called_at')}\n              required\n              className={inputClass}\n            \/>\n          <\/Labelled>\n          <Labelled label=\"Duration (minutes)\">\n            <input\n              type=\"number\"\n              min=\"0\"\n              step=\"1\"\n              value={form.duration_minutes}\n              onChange={set('duration_minutes')}\n              placeholder=\"0\"\n              className={inputClass}\n            \/>\n          <\/Labelled>\n          <Labelled label=\"Result\">\n            <select value={form.result} onChange={set('result')} className={inputClass}>\n              {RESULTS.map((r) => (\n                <option key={r.slug} value={r.slug}>\n                  {r.label}\n                <\/option>\n              ))}\n            <\/select>\n          <\/Labelled>\n          <Labelled label=\"Contact method\">\n            <select\n              value={form.contact_method}\n              onChange={set('contact_method')}\n              className={inputClass}\n            >\n              {optionsFor(choices, KIND.CONTACT_METHOD).map((c) => (\n                <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                  {c.label}\n                <\/option>\n              ))}\n            <\/select>\n          <\/Labelled>\n        <\/div>\n\n        <Labelled label=\"Next follow-up\" className=\"mt-3\">\n          <input\n            type=\"datetime-local\"\n            value={form.next_follow_up_at}\n            onChange={set('next_follow_up_at')}\n            className={inputClass}\n          \/>\n        <\/Labelled>\n\n        <Labelled label=\"Notes\" className=\"mt-3\">\n          <textarea\n            value={form.notes}\n            onChange={set('notes')}\n            rows={3}\n            placeholder=\"What was said?\"\n            className={inputClass}\n          \/>\n        <\/Labelled>\n\n        {err && <div className=\"mt-3 text-sm text-danger\">{err}<\/div>}\n\n        <div className=\"mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2\">\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={onClose}\n            className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line px-4 py-2 text-sm text-tx-2 hover:text-tx\"\n          >\n            Cancel\n          <\/button>\n          <button\n            type=\"submit\"\n            disabled={log.isPending}\n            className=\"flex items-center gap-2 rounded-ctl bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-d disabled:opacity-50\"\n          >\n            {log.isPending && <Loader2 size={14} className=\"animate-spin\" \/>}\n            Save\n          <\/button>\n        <\/div>\n      <\/form>\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\nconst inputClass =\n  'w-full rounded-ctl border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-tx placeholder:text-tx-3 focus:border-brand focus:outline-none'\n\nfunction Labelled({ label, className = '', children }) {\n  return (\n    <label className={`flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-tx-3 ${className}`}>\n      {label}\n      {children}\n    <\/label>\n  )\n}\n",

  "content" : "import { useState } from 'react'\nimport { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport {\n  ArrowLeft,\n  Building2,\n  Facebook,\n  Globe,\n  Instagram,\n  Loader2,\n  Mail,\n  MapPin,\n  MessageCircle,\n  Phone,\n  PhoneCall,\n  Trash2,\n} from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useDeleteLead, useLead, useSalesUsers, useUpdateLead } from '.\/api'\nimport { KIND, PRIORITY_TONE, TEMPERATURE_TONE, labelFor, optionsFor, scoreTone, titleCase, useCrmChoices } from '.\/crm'\nimport LeadTimeline from '.\/LeadTimeline'\nimport LogCallModal from '.\/LogCallModal'\nimport Badge from '..\/..\/components\/Badge'\nimport { fromNow, shortDate } from '..\/..\/lib\/format'\nimport { useAuth } from '..\/..\/hooks\/useAuth'\n\nconst CAN_MANAGE = ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'SALES']\nconst TABS = ['Activity', 'Calls', 'Details']\n\nexport default function LeadDetail() {\n  const { id } = useParams()\n  const navigate = useNavigate()\n  const { role } = useAuth()\n  const canManage = CAN_MANAGE.includes(role)\n\n  const { data: lead, isLoading, isError } = useLead(id)\n  const { data: choices } = useCrmChoices()\n  const [tab, setTab] = useState('Activity')\n  const [logging, setLogging] = useState(false)\n\n  if (isLoading) return <DetailSkeleton \/>\n  if (isError || !lead) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-10 text-center\">\n        <div className=\"text-tx-2\">This lead no longer exists.<\/div>\n        <Link to=\"\/leads\" className=\"mt-3 inline-block text-sm text-brand hover:underline\">\n          Back to Leads\n        <\/Link>\n      <\/div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-5\">\n      <Header lead={lead} choices={choices} canManage={canManage} onLogCall={() => setLogging(true)} \/>\n\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3\">\n        {\/* CRM state is the working surface, so it sits in the column the eye\n            lands on; the read-only business facts sit under it. *\/}\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-5 lg:col-span-1\">\n          <CrmPanel lead={lead} choices={choices} canManage={canManage} \/>\n          <BusinessPanel lead={lead} choices={choices} \/>\n        <\/div>\n\n        <div className=\"lg:col-span-2\">\n          <div className=\"mb-3 flex gap-1 rounded-ctl border border-line bg-surface p-1\">\n            {TABS.map((t) => (\n              <button\n                key={t}\n                onClick={() => setTab(t)}\n                className={`flex-1 rounded-ctl px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition ${\n                  tab === t ? 'bg-brand text-white' : 'text-tx-2 hover:text-tx'\n                }`}\n              >\n                {t}\n                {t === 'Calls' && lead.calls?.length > 0 && (\n                  <span className=\"ml-1.5 text-xs opacity-70\">{lead.calls.length}<\/span>\n                )}\n              <\/button>\n            ))}\n          <\/div>\n\n          <div className=\"rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5\">\n            {tab === 'Activity' && <LeadTimeline activities={lead.activities} \/>}\n            {tab === 'Calls' && <CallsTab lead={lead} choices={choices} \/>}\n            {tab === 'Details' && <MetaTab lead={lead} \/>}\n          <\/div>\n        <\/div>\n      <\/div>\n\n      {logging && (\n        <LogCallModal leadId={lead.id} choices={choices} onClose={() => setLogging(false)} \/>\n      )}\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction Header({ lead, choices, canManage, onLogCall }) {\n  const navigate = useNavigate()\n  const del = useDeleteLead()\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-start gap-3\">\n        <Link\n          to=\"\/leads\"\n          className=\"mt-1 rounded-ctl border border-line p-1.5 text-tx-3 hover:border-brand hover:text-brand\"\n        >\n          <ArrowLeft size={15} \/>\n        <\/Link>\n        <div>\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2\">\n            <h1 className=\"font-head text-2xl font-bold text-tx\">{lead.business_name}<\/h1>\n            {lead.is_converted && <Badge tone=\"success\">Converted<\/Badge>}\n          <\/div>\n          <div className=\"mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n            <span>{titleCase(lead.lead_type)} lead<\/span>\n            <span>·<\/span>\n            <span>{labelFor(choices, KIND.SOURCE, lead.source)}<\/span>\n            <span>·<\/span>\n            <span>Added {shortDate(lead.created_at)}<\/span>\n            <span>·<\/span>\n            <span>\n              by {lead.created_by ? lead.created_by.name || lead.created_by.email : 'System'}\n            <\/span>\n          <\/div>\n        <\/div>\n      <\/div>\n\n      {canManage && (\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n          <button\n            onClick={onLogCall}\n            className=\"flex items-center gap-2 rounded-ctl border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm text-tx-2 hover:border-brand hover:text-brand\"\n          >\n            <PhoneCall size={15} \/> Log Call\n          <\/button>\n          <button\n            onClick={() => {\n              if (window.confirm(`Delete the lead for ${lead.business_name}? This cannot be undone.`)) {\n                del.mutate(lead.id, { onSuccess: () => navigate('\/leads') })\n              }\n            }}\n            disabled={del.isPending}\n            className=\"rounded-ctl border border-line p-2 text-tx-3 hover:border-danger hover:text-danger disabled:opacity-50\"\n            aria-label=\"Delete lead\"\n          >\n            <Trash2 size={15} \/>\n          <\/button>\n        <\/div>\n      )}\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\n\/\/ Every CRM field is a live dropdown: changing one PATCHes immediately and the\n\/\/ backend writes the timeline entry. value = e.target.value\n    update.mutate({ id: lead.id, [field]: value === '__none__' ? null : value })\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5\">\n      <div className=\"mb-4 flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <h2 className=\"font-head text-sm font-semibold text-tx\">CRM<\/h2>\n        {update.isPending && <Loader2 size={13} className=\"animate-spin text-tx-3\" \/>}\n      <\/div>\n\n      <div className=\"mb-4\">\n        <div className=\"mb-1.5 flex items-baseline justify-between\">\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-tx-3\">Lead score<\/span>\n          <span className={`font-num text-lg ${tone.text}`}>{lead.lead_score}<\/span>\n        <\/div>\n        <div className=\"h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-3\">\n          <div\n            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${tone.bar}`}\n            style={{ width: `${lead.lead_score}%` }}\n          \/>\n        <\/div>\n        <div className=\"mt-1.5 text-xs text-tx-3\">\n          Calculated from priority, temperature, activity and milestones.\n        <\/div>\n      <\/div>\n\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-3\">\n        <Row label=\"Status\">\n          <Picker value={lead.status} onChange={set('status')} disabled={!canManage}>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.STATUS).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/Picker>\n        <\/Row>\n        <Row label=\"Priority\">\n          <Picker value={lead.priority} onChange={set('priority')} disabled={!canManage}>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.PRIORITY).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/Picker>\n        <\/Row>\n        <Row label=\"Temperature\">\n          <Picker value={lead.temperature} onChange={set('temperature')} disabled={!canManage}>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.TEMPERATURE).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/Picker>\n        <\/Row>\n        <Row label=\"Assigned\">\n          <Picker\n            value={lead.assigned_sales?.id ?? ''}\n            onChange={set('expected_plan')}\n            disabled={!canManage}\n          >\n            <option value=\"\">—<\/option>\n            {optionsFor(choices, KIND.EXPECTED_PLAN).map((c) => (\n              <option key={c.slug} value={c.slug}>\n                {c.label}\n              <\/option>\n            ))}\n          <\/Picker>\n        <\/Row>\n      <\/div>\n\n      <div className=\"mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-line pt-4 text-xs\">\n        <Fact label=\"Next follow-up\" value={lead.next_follow_up_at ? fromNow(lead.next_follow_up_at) : '—'} \/>\n        <Fact label=\"Last contact\" value={lead.last_contact_at ? fromNow(lead.last_contact_at) : 'Never'} \/>\n      <\/div>\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction BusinessPanel({ lead, choices }) {\n  const links = [\n    { Icon: Phone, label: lead.phone, href: lead.phone && `tel:${lead.phone}` },\n    { Icon: MessageCircle, label: lead.whatsapp, href: lead.whatsapp && `https:\/\/wa.me\/${lead.whatsapp.replace(\/\\D\/g, '')}` },\n    { Icon: Mail, label: lead.email, href: lead.email && `mailto:${lead.email}` },\n    { Icon: Instagram, label: lead.instagram, href: toUrl(lead.instagram, 'https:\/\/instagram.com\/') },\n    { Icon: Facebook, label: lead.facebook, href: toUrl(lead.facebook, 'https:\/\/facebook.com\/') },\n    { Icon: Globe, label: lead.website, href: lead.website },\n    { Icon: MapPin, label: lead.google_maps_url && 'Google Maps', href: lead.google_maps_url },\n  ].filter((l) => l.label)\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5\">\n      <h2 className=\"mb-4 font-head text-sm font-semibold text-tx\">Business<\/h2>\n\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-tx\">\n          <Building2 size={14} className=\"text-tx-3\" \/>\n          {lead.name || '—'}\n        <\/div>\n        {links.map(({ Icon, label, href }, i) => (\n          <a\n            key={i}\n            href={href || undefined}\n            target={href?.startsWith('http') ? className=\"shrink-0 text-tx-3\" \/>\n            <span className=\"truncate\">{label}<\/span>\n          <\/a>\n        ))}\n      <\/div>\n\n      <div className=\"mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 border-t text-tx-3\">Notes<\/div>\n          <p className=\"whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-tx-2\">{lead.notes}<\/p>\n        <\/div>\n      )}\n    <\/div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction CallsTab({ lead, choices }) {\n  if (!lead.calls?.length) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"py-10 text-center\">\n        <PhoneCall size={22} className=\"mx-auto mb-2 text-tx-3\" \/>\n        <div className=\"text-sm         <Badge>{titleCase(c.result)}<\/Badge>\n              <span className=\"text-xs text-tx-3\">\n                {labelFor(choices, KIND.CONTACT_METHOD, c.contact_method)}\n                {c.duration_seconds > 0 && ` · ${Math.round(c.duration_seconds \/ 60)} min`}\n              <\/span>\n            <\/div>\n            <span className=\"text-xs text-tx-3\" title={new ## 454 · Claude

Stage 2 is done — the Leads page is now a working CRM, and the table isn't a dead end because I built the details page alongside it.

**What's on screen now:**

The **KPI row** has all ten cards, and they're clickable: each one filters the table to the rows behind it. The **table** has a sticky header, server-side sort on ten columns, global search, the full filter bar (status, priority, temperature, source, category, assigned/unassigned, area, follow-up, created-date range), column visibility persisted per-user, bulk actions, skeletons, and empty states that differ depending on whether you're looking at an empty pipeline or an over-filtered one. **Add Lead** warns about duplicates as you type and again on submit, with Open / Back / Create anyway. The **details page** has the business panel, a live-editing CRM panel with the score bar, the activity timeline, and a Calls tab with Log Call.

Nothing hardcodes a status list — every dropdown and badge colour reads from Settings → CRM Configuration.

**Three things I hit that changed the work:**

**A permission gap that would have broken the feature for its main user.** `GET /admins` gates on `ADMINS_MANAGE`, which Sales deliberately doesn't hold — so the "Assigned Sales" dropdown would have 403'd for the exact role that lives in this screen. The tempting fix is widening that permission, which would hand the sales team the admin-team management API. Instead I added `GET /leads/sales-users`, returning name and email only. There's a test asserting Sales still gets 403 from `/admins`, so nobody "fixes" it the other way later.

**The Overdue card could have lied.** The KPI excludes terminal statuses (a lead that said "do not call again" isn't an overdue task), but a naive date-range drill-down wouldn't — click a card reading 3, get 5 rows. Both now share one predicate, with a test that pins them together.

**Bulk actions fan out one PATCH per lead rather than using a bulk endpoint.** That's a deliberate trade: each lead keeps its own timeline entry, re-score, and audit record — which is what you'd want when asking why forty leads changed hands at once. The cost is N requests, so it's capped at 50; past that it deserves a real endpoint rather than a loop pretending to be one.

**Verification:** 886 backend tests (up from 881), 33 frontend tests (up from 13), and all seven CI gates green — ruff, black, mypy, Django check, migrations, OpenAPI contract, pytest. The admin app lints and builds.

**What I have not done: opened this in a browser.** The build compiles and the logic is tested, but no one has looked at it rendered. Layout, spacing, and how the filter bar behaves at narrow widths are unverified — worth a look before you trust the visual side.

Remaining: Convert To Merchant, CSV/Excel import, the Settings → CRM Configuration UI (the API is done and guarded; the screen isn't built), and merging duplicates. Convert is still the one I'd flag — it should call the same provisioning as signup rather than grow a second path.

"""Account services (Phase 1.5) — settings access + contract payload builders."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from django.utils.text import slugify

from accounts.models import MerchantSettings
from billing.plans import BillingStatus
from billing.services import subscription_for
from billing.wire import plan_to_wire, status_to_wire
from core.models import Merchant


def settings_for(merchant: Merchant) -> MerchantSettings:
    """The merchant's settings row, created lazily. Idempotent."""
    obj, _ = MerchantSettings.objects.get_or_create(merchant=merchant)
    return obj


def unique_slug(name: str) -> str:
    """A unique merchant slug derived from ``name`` (``-2``, ``-3`` on collision)."""
    base = slugify(name) or "merchant"
    slug, n = base, 1
    while Merchant.objects.filter(slug=slug).exists():
        n += 1
        slug = f"{base}-{n}"
    return slug


def merchant_payload(merchant: Merchant) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Contract ``Merchant`` object with wire-mapped ``plan`` / ``status``."""
    sub = subscription_for(merchant)
    s = settings_for(merchant)
    return {
        "id": str(merchant.id),
        "name": merchant.name,
        "legal_name": merchant.legal_name,
        "slug": merchant.slug,
```

## 463 · Claude

Four things remain. Here's the honest ordering, and I looked at the signup code to make the Convert recommendation concrete rather than hand-wavy.

**I'd do Convert To Merchant next.** It's the spec's stated payoff — "eliminate duplicate data entry" — and it's the only remaining item with real risk, so it benefits most from being done while the CRM is fresh. Everything else is additive.

What I found looking at `accounts/serializers.py:39`: signup provisioning is about 30 lines inside `SignupSerializer.create` — it creates the Django `User`, the `Merchant` (via `unique_slug`), a `StaffUser` with `Role.OWNER`, the settings row, and calls `subscription_for(merchant)` to start the 14-day trial. Extracting that into `accounts/services.py` alongside `unique_slug` and `settings_for` is a small, clean move, and then both signup and convert call it.

But the comparison surfaces three gaps between what signup does and what your spec asks for:

**Signup never creates a branch.** Your spec says Convert should "Create First Branch." So that's genuinely new code, not reuse — worth knowing before I start, since it's the one part of conversion with no existing path to follow.

**Conversion has no password.** Signup takes one from the person signing up. A lead has no password and the merchant isn't in the room — so conversion has to create the owner without a usable password and send an invite. The console already has `SendPasswordResetView` and `ResendInviteView` to lean on, but it's a real branch in the flow, not a detail.

**Signup always starts a 14-day trial.** Conversion has an `expected_plan` on the lead and Sales may have just closed a paid deal. Does Convert start a trial anyway, or assign the plan Sales sold?

The other three, in the order I'd take them: **Settings → CRM Configuration UI** (the API is done and guarded, so this is just the screen — the smallest real win, and it makes the dropdown system visible to admins instead of theoretical); **CSV/Excel import**; then **merge duplicates**, which is the least valuable — the Open and Create-anyway paths already cover most of it.

Separately and cheaply: **someone should look at the UI in a browser.** I built it but never rendered it, so the visual side is unverified.

Which do you want? If it's Convert, I'll need your answer on the trial-versus-sold-plan question before I write it — the other two I can resolve sensibly on my own (branch from the lead's address, owner via invite).

## 464 · You

Sounds good. Let's do **Convert To Merchant** next.

For the conversion flow:

* If the Lead has an **expected_plan**, assign that plan directly and **skip the 14-day trial**. If no expected plan exists, start the default 14-day trial.
* Create the **first branch** automatically (default name: **Main Branch**) and prefill it from the Lead's address/location when available.
* Create the owner account with an **unusable password** and send an invitation/password setup email using the existing invite flow.
* If the Lead already has a **business logo** uploaded, automatically reuse it as the Merchant logo so Sales doesn't have to upload it again.
* Reuse as much Lead data as possible to achieve the goal of **zero duplicate data entry**, then mark the Lead as **Converted**.

I also agree with extracting the shared provisioning logic into `accounts/services.py` so both Signup and Convert use the same implementation and stay consistent.

After that, we can continue with:

1. CRM Configuration UI
2. CSV/Excel Import
3. Merge Duplicates

And before considering this phase complete, please do a quick browser pass to verify the UI visually.

## 473 · Claude

Both of those I need to flag before writing code, because one of them presumes something that doesn't exist.

**The lead has no logo, and nothing in Stampn uploads one.** `Lead` has no logo field — I didn't build one and the original spec never asked for one. And `Merchant.logo_url` is a `URLField`, not an uploaded file; there's no logo upload anywhere in the codebase (the `branding` app only does QR codes and posters). So "reuse the logo Sales already uploaded" presumes both a Lead field and an upload flow that don't exist. I can deliver the intent cheaply, but not by "reusing" — something has to be added first.

**There is no `Branch` model — it's `Location`** (`merchant`, `name`, `address`, `lat`, `lng`). So "create the first branch" means creating a `Location` named "Main Branch", prefilled from `lead.address`. That's a naming difference, not a problem — I'll build it against `Location` and keep calling it a branch in the UI, which matches how the rest of the CRM talks ("Visit Branch" is already a next action).

<sub>Everything else in your message maps cleanly onto what exists: `expected_plan` → assign-and-skip-trial is straightforward, and the unusable-password + invite path can reuse the console's existing `SendPasswordResetView` / `ResendInviteView`.</sub>

_UPLOAD_TYPE_MAP: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {
    "image/jpeg": frozenset({".jpg", ".jpeg"}),
    "image/png": frozenset({".png"}),
    "image/webp": frozenset({".webp"}),
    # SVG intentionally excluded (stored-XSS risk) — see settings.UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES.
}
_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = frozenset().union(*_UPLOAD_TYPE_MAP.values())


class UploadView(APIView):
    """POST /uploads — store a logo/image and return its URL."""

    permission_classes = [CanManageCards]
    parser_classes = [MultiPartParser, FormParser]
    serializer_class = UploadSerializer

    @extend_schema(request=UploadRequestSerializer, responses=UploadSerializer)
    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        from django.core.files.storage import default_storage

        file_obj = request.FILES.get("file")
        if file_obj is None:
            raise UnprocessableEntity("No file provided.")

        if file_obj.size > settings.UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
            raise PayloadTooLarge()

        ext = Path(file_obj.name).suffix.lower()
        allowed_exts = _UPLOAD_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS
        allowed_types = settings.UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES
        if ext not in allowed_exts or file_obj.content_type not in allowed_types:
            raise UnprocessableEntity("Unsupported file type.")
        if ext not in _UPLOAD_TYPE_MAP.get(file_obj.content_type, set()):
            raise UnprocessableEntity("File extension does not match content type.")

        safe_name = re.sub(r"[^\w.\-]", "_", Path(file_obj.name).name)
        path = default_storage.save(f"uploads/{timezone.now().timestamp()}_{safe_name}", file_obj)
        url = request.build_absolute_uri(settings.MEDIA_URL + path)
        return Response({"url": url}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

@transaction.atomic
def activate_plan(
    merchant: Merchant,
    plan: str,
    *,
    provider: str = "",
    gateway_ref: str = "",
    period_end: datetime | None = None,
) -> Subscription:
    """Convert a merchant to a paid ``plan`` (subscribe / upgrade / downgrade).

    Mirrors the plan onto ``Merchant.plan`` so the rest of the app can read it
    cheaply; ``Subscription`` remains the source of truth for access.
    """
    sub = subscription_for(merchant)
    sub.plan = plan
    sub.status = BillingStatus.ACTIVE
    sub.cancel_at_period_end = False  # a new/renewed subscription clears any pending cancel
    # ...and it is billing again, so the "we told Paymob to stop" flag no longer
    # applies. Leaving it set would make the retry sweep suspend a live sub.
    sub.gateway_billing_stopped = False
    # The interval they actually paid for now takes effect (see begin_checkout).
    if sub.pending_interval:
        sub.billing_interval = sub.pending_interval
        sub.pending_interval = ""
    if provider:
        sub.provider = provider
    if gateway_ref:
        sub.gateway_ref = gateway_ref
    sub.current_period_end = period_end
    sub.save()

    if merchant.plan != plan:
        merchant.plan = plan
        merchant.save(update_fields=["plan"])
    return sub

## 502 · Claude

I have to stop and flag this before writing any code, because one of your instructions conflicts with a rule this codebase enforces deliberately.

**"Assign that plan directly and skip the 14-day trial" would grant paid access for free.**

The billing layer draws a hard line, stated in two places in its own comments:

- `assign_enterprise_plan` (`billing/services.py:87`) — *"Records the agreement; it does **not** grant access or take money... this leaves `status` alone: an Enterprise deal signed mid-trial must not cut the trial short."*
- `AssignEnterpriseView` (`console/views_subscription.py:135`) — *"The merchant pays through the ordinary checkout and activates on the payment webhook exactly like a self-serve merchant. That is the whole point of §12.3: no second payment path to maintain."*

The only function that actually grants access is `activate_plan`, and it's called by the **payment webhook**. If Convert calls it, a converted lead gets a paid plan with `status=ACTIVE`, no trial to expire, and no payment ever taken — free forever until a human notices. If Convert instead skips the trial *without* activating, the merchant lands on `FREE`/no access with no trial either, which is worse.

Note what this means: **"assign the plan" and "skip the trial" pull in opposite directions here.** Skipping the trial is only safe *if* something else grants access, and the only safe thing that grants access is payment.

The shape that fits the existing architecture — and still gets Sales what they want — is: Convert records the negotiated plan on the subscription (exactly as `assign_enterprise_plan` does), leaves the trial running, and hands Sales the checkout URL to send. The merchant activates on payment, through the one path that already exists. Sales still does zero re-entry; the plan they sold is already recorded.

<sub>I'd rather raise this now than discover it after a converted merchant has been on Pro for three months without an invoice. It's possible you meant "record the sold plan so they're not re-picking it at checkout," which is exactly what the recommended option does.</sub>

## 508 · Claude

Confirmed a mismatch that decides the design: Stampn's real tiers are **FREE, STARTER, GROWTH, CHAIN, ENTERPRISE** — but the spec's `expected_plan` vocabulary is *Trial, Basic, Pro, Enterprise, Custom*. "Basic" and "Pro" don't exist in this product. Only Enterprise lines up.

So `expected_plan` can't mechanically choose a real plan. I'm not going to invent a Basic→Starter mapping and bake it into billing — that would silently trial merchants on a plan nobody chose. Instead the Convert modal will have Sales pick from the **real** plan catalogue (`GET /plans`), prefilled from `expected_plan` only where the slug genuinely matches. `expected_plan` stays what it is: a sales forecast. That's one dropdown, still zero re-entry, and no guessing. Telling you rather than asking a fourth time.

class ResetView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    throttle_scope = "auth"

    @extend_schema(request=ResetSerializer, responses=OkSerializer)
    def post(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        body = ResetSerializer(data=request.data)
        body.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        reset = PasswordResetToken.objects.filter(token=body.validated_data["token"]).first()
        if reset is None or not reset.is_valid():
            raise TokenExpired("This reset link is invalid or has expired.")
        user = reset.user
        user.set_password(body.validated_data["password"])
        user.save(update_fields=["password"])
        reset.used_at = timezone.now()
        reset.save(update_fields=["used_at"])
        return Response({"ok": True})


class InviteView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    throttle_scope = "auth"

    def _resolve(self, token: str) -> StaffInvite:
        invite = (
            StaffInvite.objects.select_related("merchant", "location").filter(token=token).first()
        )
        if invite is None or not invite.is_valid():
            raise TokenExpired("This invite is invalid or has expired.")
        return invite

    @extend_schema(responses=InviteInfoSerializer)
    def get(self, request: Request, t: str) -> Response:
        invite = self._resolve(t)
        return Response(
            {"merchant_name": invite.merchant.name, "role": invite.role, "email": invite.email}
        )

    @extend_schema(request=InviteAcceptSerializer, responses=TokenPairSerializer)
    def post(self, request: Request, t: str) -> Response:
        invite = self._resolve(t)
        body = InviteAcceptSerializer(data=request.data)
        body.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        if User.objects.filter(username__iexact=invite.email).exists():
            raise Conflict("An account with this email already exists.")

## 522 · Claude

Found a blocker that makes your instruction impossible as literally stated — worth knowing before I build it:

**`InviteView.post` refuses when the user already exists** (`accounts/views.py`): `raise Conflict("An account with this email already exists.")`. So "create the owner with an unusable password **and** send the invite" would produce an invite that is guaranteed to fail on accept, 100% of the time. The invite flow is designed for accounts that *don't* exist yet — it creates the user on accept.

The flow that *does* work with an existing account is the password-reset link (`ResetView`), which is what `SendPasswordResetView` already uses. Its only problem is the 1-hour TTL — which I can set explicitly to 7 days at creation (`expires_at` is a plain field default, no model change), matching `INVITE_TTL_DAYS`.

That satisfies exactly what you asked for: owner created with an unusable password, Sales never sees or sets it, merchant sets their own via a link that's still alive tomorrow. Building it that way.

  "content" : "\"\"\"Image upload validation + storage — one implementation, two boundaries.\n\nThe merchant dashboard (``POST \/uploads``, merchant JWT) and the admin console's\nlead-logo upload (``POST \/admin\/v1\/leads\/{id}\/logo``, admin JWT) both take an\nimage from a user and put it in storage. They authenticate completely\ndifferently and always will; what must never differ is what they *accept*.\n\nHence this module. The rules here are a security boundary, not a convenience:\nSVG is excluded because it executes script when served (stored XSS), and the\ndeclared content-type is cross-checked against the extension because a caller\ncontrols both and will happily claim ``image\/png`` for a ``.svg``. Duplicating\nthat per endpoint is how one copy quietly falls behind the other.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom django.conf import settings\nfrom django.core.files.storage import default_storage\nfrom django.utils import timezone\n\nfrom common.errors import PayloadTooLarge, UnprocessableEntity\n\n# Content-type → the extensions it may legitimately carry. SVG is deliberately\n# absent: it is an executable document, and serving one from our own origin\n# hands an attacker script execution against our users.\nUPLOAD_TYPE_MAP: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"image\/jpeg\": frozenset({\".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}),\n    \"image\/png\": frozenset({\".png\"}),\n    \"image\/webp\": frozenset({\".webp\"}),\n}\n\nALLOWED_EXTENSIONS: frozenset[str] = frozenset().union(*UPLOAD_TYPE_MAP.values())\n\n\ndef save_image(file_obj, *, prefix: str = \"uploads\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Validate ``file_obj`` and store it. Returns the storage path.\n\n    Raises ``PayloadTooLarge`` \/ ``UnprocessableEntity`` — both DomainErrors, so\n    each boundary renders them in its own error shape without either knowing\n    about the other.\n\n    ``prefix`` separates what came from where in storage; it is not a security\n    control (the checks below are), just a way to keep merchant uploads and\n    lead logos from sharing one undifferentiated folder.\n    \"\"\"\n    if file_obj is None:\n        raise UnprocessableEntity(\"No file provided.\")\n\n    if file_obj.size > settings.UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_BYTES:\n        raise PayloadTooLarge()\n\n    ext = Path(file_obj.name).suffix.lower()\n    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS or file_obj.content_type not in settings.UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES:\n        raise UnprocessableEntity(\"Unsupported file type.\")\n    # The caller controls both the name and the declared type, so agreement\n    # between them is the check that matters — either alone is trivially forged.\n    if ext not in UPLOAD_TYPE_MAP.get(file_obj.content_type, frozenset()):\n        raise UnprocessableEntity(\"File extension does not match content type.\")\n\n    safe_name = re.sub(r\"[^\\w.\\-]\", \"_\", Path(file_obj.name).name)\n    return default_storage.save(f\"{prefix}\/{timezone.now().timestamp()}_{safe_name}\", file_obj)\n\n\ndef absolute_url(request, path: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The stored ``path`` as a URL the browser can fetch.\"\"\"\n    return request.build_absolute_uri(settings.MEDIA_URL + path)\n",

"""Account services (Phase 1.5) — settings access + contract payload builders."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from django.utils.text import slugify

from accounts.models import MerchantSettings
from billing.plans import BillingStatus
from billing.services import subscription_for
from billing.wire import plan_to_wire, status_to_wire
from core.models import Merchant


def settings_for(merchant: Merchant) -> MerchantSettings:
    """The merchant's settings row, created lazily. Idempotent."""
    obj, _ = MerchantSettings.objects.get_or_create(merchant=merchant)
    return obj

{
  "content" : "\"\"\"Convert-To-Merchant — the point of the whole CRM.\n\nSales closes a lead and everything they already typed becomes the merchant's\naccount: no re-entry, no copy-paste, no second system. That goal is the reason\nthis module exists at all, and it is also the reason it is careful.\n\nTwo rules it will not bend:\n\n**It does not grant paid access.** Provisioning goes through\n``accounts.services.provision_merchant``, the same function self-serve signup\ncalls, which starts the ordinary trial. When Sales has sold a plan, that plan is\nwhat the merchant *trials on* — ``Subscription.plan`` is documented as \"the plan\nthe merchant picked at the gate, what they trial on and what Paymob auto-charges\nat trial end\" — and payment activates it through the usual webhook. Convert\nnever calls ``activate_plan``. Doing so would grant a paid plan to someone who\nhas not paid, and create the second payment path §12.3 exists to prevent.\n\n**It does not set a password.** A lead never gave us one, and Sales must not\ninvent one they would then have to tell the merchant. The owner is created with\nan unusable password and emailed a link to set their own. That link is a\n``PasswordResetToken`` rather than a ``StaffInvite`` because the invite flow\n(``accounts.views.InviteView``) refuses an email that already has an account —\nand by this point the owner *does* have one. Its expiry is set explicitly to the\ninvite TTL: the one-hour reset default is right for \"I forgot my password, send\nit now\" and wrong for \"welcome, set up your account\", which someone reads after\nlunch.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom datetime import timedelta\n\nfrom django.conf import settings\nfrom django.core.mail import send_mail\nfrom django.db import transaction\nfrom django.utils import timezone\n\nfrom accounts.models import INVITE_TTL_DAYS, PasswordResetToken\nfrom accounts.services import provision_merchant\nfrom billing.models import Plan, Subscription\nfrom billing.services import subscription_for\nfrom console import crm, crm_service\nfrom console.models import AdminUser, Lead\nfrom core.enums import PlanTier\nfrom core.models import Location, StaffUser\n\n# What the first branch is called when the lead gives us nothing better. The\n# lead has an area and an address but never a branch name — a shop's first\n# location is just \"the shop\".\nDEFAULT_BRANCH_NAME = \"Main Branch\"\n\n\nclass ConversionError(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A lead that cannot be converted, with a reason meant for a salesperson.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):\n        self.code = code\n        self.message = message\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\ndef _resolve_plan(plan_key: str) -> tuple[str, Plan | None]:\n    \"\"\"Map a plan key from the Convert form onto (tier, negotiated plan row).\n\n    Enterprise is two-part in this codebase: the *tier* says ENTERPRISE and\n    ``Subscription.enterprise_plan`` names which negotiated deal. A public tier\n    (Starter\/Growth\/Chain) is just itself.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not plan_key:\n        return \"\", None\n\n    if plan_key in PlanTier.values:\n        return plan_key, None\n\n    # Not a tier, so it must be a negotiated plan row (Enterprise Gold, …).\n    plan = Plan.objects.filter(key=plan_key, archived=False).first()\n    if plan is None:\n        raise ConversionError(\"UNKNOWN_PLAN\", f\"'{plan_key}' is not a live plan.\")\n    if plan.is_public:\n        # Mirrors assign_enterprise_plan's guard: a public tier is bought at\n        # self-serve. Putting a merchant on ENTERPRISE while resolving to\n        # Growth's limits is a confusing state with no legitimate use.\n        raise ConversionError(\n            \"PUBLIC_PLAN_NOT_NEGOTIABLE\",\n            f\"{plan.key} is a public plan — pick its tier instead.\",\n        )\n    return PlanTier.ENTERPRISE, plan\n\n\ndef _apply_sold_plan(merchant, plan_key: str) -> Subscription:\n    \"\"\"Put the merchant on the plan Sales sold — as a *trial*, not as access.\n\n    Sets what the merchant trials on and what they will be charged for at trial\n    end. Status is left at TRIALING by ``subscription_for``; only the payment\n    webhook makes it ACTIVE.\n    \"\"\"\n    sub = subscription_for(merchant)\n    tier, negotiated = _resolve_plan(plan_key)\n    if not tier:\n        return sub  # no plan sold — the default trial stands\n\n    sub.plan = tier\n    sub.enterprise_plan = negotiated\n    sub.save(update_fields=[\"plan\", \"enterprise_plan\", \"updated_at\"])\n\n    # Merchant.plan mirrors the tier so the rest of the app reads it cheaply;\n    # Subscription stays the source of truth for access.\n    if merchant.plan != tier:\n        merchant.plan = tier\n        merchant.save(update_fields=[\"plan\"])\n    return sub\n\n\ndef _send_setup_email(staff: StaffUser, merchant_name: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Email the new owner a link to set their own password.\n\n    Best-effort by design: the merchant, branch and owner are already committed\n    by the time this runs, and a bounced SMTP call must not roll that back and\n    leave Sales staring at a lead that failed to convert for a reason they\n    cannot act on. If it fails, the console's existing \"Send password reset\"\n    support action re-sends it.\n    \"\"\"\n    reset = PasswordResetToken.objects.create(\n        user=staff.user,\n        expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(days=INVITE_TTL_DAYS),\n    )\n    send_mail(\n        subject=f\"Welcome to Stampn — set up {merchant_name}\",\n        message=(\n            f\"Your Stampn account for {merchant_name} is ready.\\n\\n\"\n            \"Set your password to get started:\\n\\n\"\n            f\"{settings.DASHBOARD_BASE_URL}\/reset\/{reset.token}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"This link is valid for {INVITE_TTL_DAYS} days.\"\n        ),\n        from_email=None,\n        recipient_list=[staff.user.email],\n        fail_silently=True,\n    )\n\n\n@transaction.atomic\ndef convert_lead(lead: Lead, *, actor: AdminUser, plan_key: str = \"\") -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Turn ``lead`` into a live merchant. Returns the created objects.\n\n    Atomic: a lead is either fully converted — merchant, owner, branch,\n    subscription, timeline, and the lead itself marked Converted — or nothing\n    happened. A half-converted lead is the worst outcome available here, because\n    the next attempt would collide with the merchant the first one left behind.\n    \"\"\"\n    if lead.is_converted:\n        raise ConversionError(\n            \"ALREADY_CONVERTED\",\n            f\"{lead.business_name} was already converted on \"\n            f\"{lead.converted_at:%d %b %Y}.\" if lead.converted_at else \"Already converted.\",\n        )\n    if not lead.email:\n        # The owner account is keyed on email and the setup link is emailed to\n        # it. Without one there is no account to make and no way to hand it over.\n        raise ConversionError(\n            \"EMAIL_REQUIRED\",\n            \"Add an email address to this lead before converting it — \"\n            \"the owner's login and setup link both need one.\",\n        )\n\n    from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model\n\n    if get_user_model().objects.filter(username__iexact=lead.email).exists():\n        raise ConversionError(\n            \"EMAIL_IN_USE\",\n            f\"{lead.email} already has a Stampn account. \"\n            \"Link this lead to that merchant instead of converting it.\",\n        )\n\n    staff = provision_merchant(\n        business_name=lead.business_name,\n        owner_name=lead.name or lead.business_name,\n        email=lead.email,\n        phone=lead.phone,\n        password=None,  # unusable — the owner sets their own via the link below\n        logo_url=lead.logo_url,\n    )\n    merchant = staff.merchant\n\n    sub = _apply_sold_plan(merchant, plan_key)\n\n    # The first branch. Prefilled from whatever the lead knows: its address, or\n    # failing that its area, which is the only location most walk-in leads have.\n    branch = Location.objects.create(\n        merchant=merchant,\n        name=DEFAULT_BRANCH_NAME,\n        address=lead.address or lead.area,\n    )\n\n    lead.converted_merchant = merchant\n    lead.converted_at = timezone.now()\n    lead.status = crm.LeadStatus.CONVERTED\n    lead.save(update_fields=[\"converted_merchant\", \"converted_at\", \"status\", \"updated_at\"])\n\n    crm_service.log_activity(\n        lead,\n        crm.ActivityKind.CONVERTED_TO_MERCHANT,\n        \"Converted To Merchant\",\n        description=(\n            f\"{merchant.name} created on the {sub.plan} plan. \"\n            f\"Setup link sent to {lead.email}.\"\n        ),\n        actor=actor,\n    )\n\n    # After the timeline entry, so a failed send cannot cost us the record of\n    # the conversion itself.\n    _send_setup_email(staff, merchant.name)\n\n    return {\"merchant\": merchant, \"owner\": staff, \"branch\": branch, \"subscription\": sub}\n",

Test-harness only.\nimport crypto from 'crypto'\nconst B32 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567'\nexport function totp(secret, t = Date.now()) {\n  let bits = ''\n  for (const c of secret.replace(\/=+$\/, '')) bits += B32.indexOf(c.toUpperCase()).toString(2).padStart(5, '0')\n  const bytes = Buffer.from(bits.match(\/.{8}\/g).map(b => parseInt(b, 2)))\n  const counter = Buffer.alloc(8)\n  counter.writeBigInt64BE(BigInt(Math.floor(t \/ 1000 \/ 30)))\n  const h = crypto.createHmac('sha1', bytes).update(counter).digest()\n  const o = h[h.length - 1] & 0xf\n  return String(((h.readUInt32BE(o) & 0x7fffffff) % 1e6)).padStart(6, '0')\n}\nEOF\nnode -e \"import('.\/_totp.mjs').then(m => console.log('node code:', m.totp('JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXPJBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP')))\"",

## 731 · Claude

Convert To Merchant is done, and the browser pass you asked for found real bugs — which is exactly why it was worth doing.

**Convert works end-to-end.** I clicked it in a real browser against a seeded pipeline and verified what came out: `Cairo Juice Bar` → merchant with slug `cairo-juice-bar`, owner `sara@cairo.com` (role OWNER, **unusable password**), `Main Branch` at the lead's address, contact details carried across, subscription **TRIALING on the sold plan**, a **valid 7-day** setup link, and the lead marked Converted with a timeline entry. The KPI cards updated live and stayed consistent with the table — Customers 1, Conversion 10%, Demo Scheduled 1→0.

**What the browser pass caught that 908 tests didn't:** `GET /plans` was returning **500**, which the Convert modal depends on. It turned out to be my dev database being behind — six unapplied billing migrations — not a code defect, but I'd never have known without loading the page. Also fixed uneven row heights from status/owner text wrapping mid-badge.

**Three things I built differently from what you asked, each because the codebase said so:**

1. **The invite flow can't be used.** `InviteView` refuses an email that already has an account — and Convert creates the owner — so "unusable password + send the invite" would have failed 100% of the time on accept. Convert sends a password-reset link instead (the flow that *does* work for existing accounts), with the expiry set explicitly to 7 days rather than the 1-hour default.

2. **The plan picker uses the real catalogue.** `expected_plan` is Trial/Basic/Pro/Enterprise/Custom; Stampn's actual tiers are FREE/STARTER/GROWTH/CHAIN/ENTERPRISE. Basic and Pro don't exist, so rather than invent a mapping I had Sales confirm the plan — one dropdown, no guessing.

3. **Your trial adjustment turned out to be exactly right.** `Subscription.plan` is already documented as "what they trial on and what Paymob auto-charges at trial end", so trialing on the sold plan needed no new billing path at all — just set `plan`, leave `status=TRIALING`. There's a test named `test_convert_never_grants_paid_access` that fails if anyone ever makes Convert call `activate_plan`.

**Also worth knowing:** I found Stampn *does* have an upload pipeline (`POST /uploads`) — I was wrong earlier when I said it didn't. So the logo work was much cheaper than the option you picked implied: I extracted its validation into `common/uploads.py` (shared, since SVG-exclusion and content-type cross-checking are a security boundary that must not diverge) and added an admin-side endpoint, because the existing one is merchant-JWT-only.

**Verification:** 908 backend tests (22 new for Convert), 33 frontend tests, all seven CI gates green, plus the browser pass with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow on mobile.

Next up per your list: **CRM Configuration UI**, then CSV/Excel Import, then Merge Duplicates. Say the word.

import { useState } from 'react'
import { Loader2, Plus, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useFlags, useCreateFlag, useUpdateFlag, useSetOverride, useClearOverride } from './api'
import { normalizeError } from '../../lib/api'

export default function FlagsTab({ canManage }) {
  const { data: flags, isLoading } = useFlags()
  const createFlag = useCreateFlag()
  const updateFlag = useUpdateFlag()
  const setOverride = useSetOverride()
  const clearOverride = useClearOverride()
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ key: '', label: '', enabled: false })

  if (isLoading || !flags) return <Loader2 className="mx-auto mt-10 animate-spin text-tx-3" />

  async function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault()
    try {
      await createFlag.mutateAsync({
        key: form.key.trim(),
        label: form.label,
        enabled: form.enabled,
      })
      setForm({ key: '', label: '', enabled: false })
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(normalizeError(err).message)
    }
  }

  async function toggle(flag) {
    try {
      await updateFlag.mutateAsync({ key: flag.key, patch: { enabled: !flag.enabled } })
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(normalizeError(err).message)
    }
  }

  async function addOverride(flag) {
    const merchant_id = window.prompt(`Merchant ID to override "${flag.key}" for:`)
    if (!merchant_id) return
    const on = window.confirm('OK = enable for this merchant, Cancel = disable')
    try {
      await setOverride.mutateAsync({
        key: flag.key,
        body: { merchant_id: merchant_id.trim(), enabled: on },
      })
    } catch (err) {
      window.alert(normalizeError(err).message)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {canManage && (
        <form
          onSubmit={submit}
          className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4"

            />
          </label>

## 822 · Claude

CRM Configuration UI is done, verified in the browser, and all gates are green.

**The screen** lives at `/leads/settings`, reached by a gear in the Leads header (super-admin only). All eight dropdown groups are editable — inline label editing, a colour picker per row, an Active toggle, and an add box. Sales Users appear read-only with a link to Admin Team, since they're admin accounts, not CRM vocabulary.

I put it beside the CRM rather than under Operations → Settings, because that tab is platform config owned by Engineering, while `CRM_CONFIGURE` is super-admin-only and this is the sales vocabulary. It's where someone would go looking for it.

**The browser pass proved the whole design works end-to-end:**
- Renaming "New Lead" → "Fresh Lead" in settings **changed the leads table immediately** — that's the system-vs-configurable split doing exactly what it was built for, with nothing hardcoded.
- Deleting a built-in was refused with the server's real explanation: *"A built-in value cannot be deleted — the CRM reads it by name. Deactivate it instead."*
- Adding a custom status derived the slug `ghosted` correctly and it became selectable in the CRM.

**It also caught a UX mistake of mine.** I'd rendered a delete button on every row, including the 24 built-ins where it could *only* ever produce an error. A button whose sole outcome is failure shouldn't exist — the lock badge already explains it, and unticking Active is what people actually want. Now: 0 delete buttons on built-in statuses, 11 on the custom categories. I'd have shipped that if I hadn't looked.

Two smaller things worth noting: I moved `slugify` into `crm.js` and tested it (accents matter — "Café" must become `cafe`, matching the seeded category, not `caf`), since the server refuses re-slugging and a typo there would be permanent. And I replaced a regex containing literal invisible combining characters with the explicit `\u0300-\u036f` range — same behavior, but the next person can see what it does.

**Verification:** 908 backend tests, 37 frontend tests (up from 33), all seven CI gates clean, browser pass with zero console errors. I reset the demo data I mutated during testing and removed all scratch artifacts.

Remaining from your list: **CSV/Excel Import**, then **Merge Duplicates**. Import is the bigger one — column mapping, dedupe, and a summary. Want me to continue?

Only plain text fields are importable: status, priority and the rest\n# are CRM state that the pipeline sets, not facts about the business.\nIMPORTABLE_FIELDS: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {\n    \"business_name\": {\n        \"label\": \"Business\",\n        \"required\": True,\n        \"aliases\": (\"business\", \"business name\", \"company\", \"name\", \"shop\", \"store\", \"title\"),\n    },\n    \"name\": {\n        \"label\": \"Owner\",\n        \"aliases\": (\"owner\", \"owner name\", \"contact\", \"contact name\", \"person\", \"full name\"),\n    },\n    \"phone\": {\n        \"label\": \"Phone\",\n        \"required\": True,\n        \"aliases\": (\"phone\", \"phone number\", \"mobile\", \"telephone\", \"tel\", \"number\"),\n    },\n    \"whatsapp\": {\"label\": \"WhatsApp\", \"aliases\": (\"whatsapp\", \"whats app\", \"wa\")},\n    \"email\": {\"label\": \"Email\", \"aliases\": (\"email\", \"e mail\", \"mail\", \"email address\")},\n    \"area\": {\"label\": \"Area\", \"aliases\": (\"area\", \"district\", \"neighbourhood\", \"neighborhood\", \"zone\")},\n    \"address\": {\"label\": \"Address\", \"aliases\": (\"address\", \"street\", \"location\", \"full address\")},\n    \"website\": {\"label\": \"Website\", \"aliases\": (\"website\", \"web\", \"site\", \"url\")},\n    \"instagram\": {\"label\": \"Instagram\", \"aliases\": (\"instagram\", \"ig\", \"insta\")},\n    \"facebook\": {\"label\": \"Facebook\", \"aliases\": (\"facebook\", \"fb\")},\n    \"google_maps_url\": {\n        \"label\": \"Google Maps\",\n        \"aliases\": (\"google maps\", {\"label\": \"Notes\", \"aliases\": (\"notes\", \"note\", \"comment\", \"comments\", \"remarks\")},\n}\n\nREQUIRED_FIELDS: tuple[str, ...] = tuple(\n    f for f, spec in IMPORTABLE_FIELDS.items() if a picker is not worth it yet\n        rows_iter = sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True)\n        header = next(rows_iter, None)\n        if not header:\n            raise ImportError_(\"NO_COLUMNS\", \"This file has no header row.\")\n\n        columns = [str(c).strip() for c in header if c is not None and str(c).strip()]\n        if not columns:\n            raise ImportError_(\"NO_COLUMNS\", \"This file has no header row.\")\n\n        rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []\n        for values in rows_iter:\n            # openpyxl pads trailing empties with None; a wholly blank line is\n            # the spreadsheet equivalent of whitespace, so skip rather than\n            # count it as a failure in the summary.\n            if values is None or all(v is None or str(v).strip() == \"\" for v in values):\n                continue\n            if len(rows) >= MAX_ROWS:\n                raise ImportError_(\n                    \"TOO_MANY_ROWS\", f\"This file has more than {MAX_ROWS:,} rows — split it up.\"\n                )\n            rows.append({c: _clean(v) for c, v in zip(columns, values)})\n        return columns, rows\n    finally:\n        book.close()  # read_only workbooks hold the file handle open\n\n\ndef _clean(value: Any) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A cell as trimmed text. Numbers come back from Excel as floats, so a\n    phone number in a numeric column arrives as 1000000000.0 — a lead nobody\n    can call. Render whole floats without the tail.\"\"\"\n    if value is None:\n        return \"\"\n    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():\n        return str(int(value))\n    return str(value).strip()\n\n\ndef validate_mapping(mapping: dict[str, str]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Refuse a mapping that cannot produce a usable lead.\"\"\"\n    fields = set(mapping.values())\n    unknown = fields - set(IMPORTABLE_FIELDS)\n    if unknown:\n        raise ImportError_(\"UNKNOWN_FIELD\", f\"Cannot import into: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}.\")\n\n    missing = [IMPORTABLE_FIELDS[f][\"label\"] for f in REQUIRED_FIELDS if f not in fields]\n    if missing:\n        raise ImportError_(\n            \"MISSING_REQUIRED\",\n            f\"Map a column to {' and '.join(missing)} — a lead needs them.\",\n        )\n\n    duplicated = [f for f in fields if list(mapping.values()).count(f) > 1]\n    if duplicated:\n        raise ImportError_(\n            \"DUPLICATE_FIELD\",\n            f\"Two columns are mapped to {IMPORTABLE_FIELDS[duplicated[0]]['label']}.\",\n        )\n\n\ndef _category_slug(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Match a category cell to a configured category, by slug or by label.\n\n    Unmatched categories are dropped rather than invented: creating CrmChoice\n    rows from a spreadsheet would let one messy import fill everyone's dropdown\n    with \"cafe \", \"Café \" and \"CAFE\" forever.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not value:\n        return \"\"\n    probe = _normalise(value)\n    for choice in CrmChoice.objects.filter(kind=crm.CrmChoiceKind.CATEGORY, is_active=True):\n        if _normalise(choice.slug) == probe or _normalise(choice.label) == probe:\n            return choice.slug\n    return \"\"\n\n\ndef import_rows(\n    rows: list[dict[str, str]],\n    mapping: dict[str, str],\n    *,\n    actor: AdminUser,\n    source: str = crm.LeadSource.OTHER,\n    assigned_sales: AdminUser | None = None,\n    skip_duplicates: bool = True,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Create a lead per row.
